tasks.gr6-capacity-t4: Topic: Capacity and volume. Cover the meaning of capacity, metric units (millilitres and litres), conversion between ml and l, reading a measuring jug, and solving capacity problems in context. Ask Grade 6 learners to convert between ml and l, read measuring jugs, and solve practical capacity problems.
tasks.gr6-data-handling-t4: Topic: Data handling and statistics. Cover the mean, mode, median, and range of a data set, reading bar graphs and pie charts, and interpreting information from graphs. Ask Grade 6 learners to calculate mean, mode, median, and range, and read and interpret different types of graphs.
tasks.gr6-mass-t4: Topic: Mass and weight. Cover units of mass (grams, kilograms, tonnes), converting between units, reading scales, and solving mass problems in context. Ask Grade 6 learners to convert between mass units, read mass from scales, and solve practical mass problems.
tasks.gr6-problem-solving-t4: Topic: Multi-step problem solving. Cover reading word problems carefully, identifying key information, planning solution steps, performing calculations, and checking answers. Ask Grade 6 learners to solve multi-step word problems involving all four operations, fractions, and measurement in real-world contexts.
tasks.gr6-time-t4: Topic: Time. Cover reading analogue and digital clocks, 12-hour and 24-hour time formats, converting between them, and calculating elapsed time and duration. Ask Grade 6 learners to read clocks, convert between 12-hour and 24-hour time, and calculate time differences.
